# Parse the file content to extract song titles and artists.
content = _mem['s10']['content']
lines = [line.strip() for line in content.splitlines() if line.strip()]
songs_to_archive = []
for line in lines:
    # Remove leading "- " if present
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " (last occurrence)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artist = line.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        songs_to_archive.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
    else:
        # If no artist, maybe just title? But file format has artist.
        songs_to_archive.append((line.strip(), ''))
print(songs_to_archive)

# Parse the songs from the file content
import re

content = _mem['s10']['content']
songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Remove leading "- " and split on " by " (last occurrence)
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split on " by " from the right
        parts = song_str.rsplit(' by ', 1)
        if len(parts) == 2:
            title, artist = parts[0].strip(), parts[1].strip()
            songs.append((title, artist))

print(f"Parsed {len(songs)} songs")
for title, artist in songs:
